IRS990.Desc: PRESIDIO KNOLLS SCHOOOL (PKS) IS A PRIVATE, NON-PROFIT, COEDUCATIONAL SCHOOL FOUNDED AS A PRESCHOOL IN 2006 IN SAN FRANCISCO, CALIFORNIA, OFFERING A REGGIO EMILIA INSPIRED EDUCATIONAL APPROACH WITH MANDARIN IMMERSION PROGRAM. IN 2012, THE SCHOOL BEGAN AN EMERGING K-8 PROGRAM. DURING THE YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2025, ENROLLMENT IN THE SCHOOL, CURRENTLY WITH PRESCHOOL THROUGH 8TH GRADE, WAS APPROXIMATELY 400 STUDENTS.AUXILIARY PROGRAMS PROVIDE STUDENTS WITH OPPORTUNITIES TO ENGAGE IN SUPERVISED ACTIVITIES BEYOND THE REGULAR SCHOOL DAY IN A FAMILIAR SCHOOL ENVIRONMENT. PROGRAMS INCLUDE EXTENDED CARE, ENRICHMENT CLASSES, ATHLETICS, AND SUMMER CAMP OFFERINGS. (SEE SCHEDULE O)EXTENDED CARE IS OFFERED BEFORE AND AFTER SCHOOL WITH ADVANCE REGISTRATION. ACTIVITIES INCLUDE OUTDOOR PLAY, FREE-CHOICE ACTIVITY CENTERS, AND SNACKS FOR PRESCHOOL STUDENTS, AND SUPERVISED FREE PLAY AND OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES FOR ELEMENTARY AND MIDDLE SCHOOL STUDENTS. OPTIONAL FEE-BASED ENRICHMENT CLASSES ARE AVAILABLE DURING EXTENDED CARE HOURS.ENRICHMENT PROGRAMS ARE OFFERED THROUGHOUT THE SCHOOL YEAR ON CAMPUS AND INCLUDE A VARIETY OF FEE-BASED CLASSES SUCH AS ART, ROBOTICS, CHESS, LANGUAGE, PERFORMING ARTS, AND OTHER SEASONAL OFFERINGS FOR PRESCHOOL THROUGH MIDDLE SCHOOL STUDENTS.ATHLETICS PROGRAMS PROMOTE PHYSICAL FITNESS, TEAMWORK, AND SOCIAL-EMOTIONAL DEVELOPMENT THROUGH PARTICIPATION IN RECREATIONAL LEAGUES AND SEASONAL SPORTS SUCH AS SOCCER, VOLLEYBALL, BASKETBALL, AND FUTSAL. PROGRAMS ARE OPEN TO ALL INTERESTED STUDENTS.SUMMER CAMP OFFERS A K-8 MANDARIN IMMERSION PROGRAM FOR ENROLLED STUDENTS AND THE BROADER COMMUNITY, PROVIDING EDUCATIONAL AND RECREATIONAL ACTIVITIES DURING THE SUMMER MONTHS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL IS A QUALIFIED ORGANIZATION EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME AND STATE FRANCHISE TAXES UNDER 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE ("IRC") AND 23701D OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE, RESPECTIVELY. ACCORDINGLY, THE SCHOOL IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL AND CALIFORNIA INCOME TAXES AND IS NOT LIABLE FOR FEDERAL UNEMPLOYMENT TAXES. U.S. GAAP REQUIRES MANAGEMENT TO EVALUATE THE TAX POSITIONS TAKEN AND RECOGNIZE A TAX LIABILITY (OR ASSET) IF THE SCHOOL HAS TAKEN AN UNCERTAIN TAX POSITION THAT MORE-LIKELY-THAN-NOT WOULD NOT BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION BY TAXING AUTHORITIES. MANAGEMENT EVALUATED THE SCHOOL'S TAX POSITIONS AND CONCLUDED THAT IT MAINTAINED ITS TAX-EXEMPT STATUS AND HAD TAKEN NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS THAT WOULD REQUIRE ADJUSTMENT TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. THEREFORE, NO PROVISION OR LIABILITY FOR UNKNOWN INCOME TAXES HAS BEEN INCLUDED IN THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. THE SCHOOL'S TAX RETURNS ARE SUBJECT TO EXAMINATION BY FEDERAL AND STATE TAXING AUTHORITIES. HOWEVER, THERE ARE NO EXAMINATIONS IN PROGRESS NOR ARE THERE ANY PENDING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL OFFERS ADJUSTED TUITION ON THE BASIS OF DEMONSTRATED FINANCIAL NEED. AN INDEPENDENT THIRD-PARTY SERVICE, CLARITY, USED BY MANY SCHOOLS, PROVIDES AN OBJECTIVE EVALUATION OF EACH FAMILY'S FINANCIAL NEED. BASED ON THIS ASSESSMENT AND AVAILABLE FUNDING, GRANTS ARE AWARDED TO AS MANY ELIGIBLE APPLICANTS AS POSSIBLE. ADDITIONAL PROGRAMS MAY ALSO HELP OFFSET TUITION COSTS. PKS IS AN APPROVED PROVIDER FOR ELFA FUNDING THROUGH THE CITY OF SAN FRANCISCO FOR FAMILIES EARNING LESS THAN 150% OF AREA MEDIAN INCOME. FAMILIES ARE ENCOURAGED TO COMPLETE THE STANDARD ADMISSIONS AND ADJUSTED TUITION APPLICATION PROCESS, AFTER WHICH ELIGIBILITY IS EVALUATED TO DETERMINE WHETHER ELFA FUNDING MAY FURTHER REDUCE TUITION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE, BOARD FINANCE COMMITTEE AND BOARD FUNDRAISING/DEVELOPMENT COMMITTEE REVIEW THE TAX RETURN PRIOR TO FILING. THE BOARD FINANCE COMMITTEE APPROVES THE FINAL TAX RETURN PRIOR TO FILING. AFTER FILING, THE PUBLIC DISCLOSURE COPY IS SHARED WITH ALL COMMITTEE MEMBERS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAINTAINS A WRITTEN CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY APPLICABLE TO BOARD MEMBERS, OFFICERS, AND KEY EMPLOYEES. COVERED INDIVIDUALS ARE REQUIRED TO PROVIDE WRITTEN DISCLOSURE OF ANY ACTUAL OR POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST UPON HIRE, ELECTION, OR APPOINTMENT AND ANNUALLY THEREAFTER, INCLUDING DIRECT OR INDIRECT FINANCIAL INTERESTS, BUSINESS AFFILIATIONS, NONPROFIT INVOLVEMENT, AND INTERESTS OF FAMILY MEMBERS OR SIGNIFICANT OTHERS. THESE DISCLOSURES ARE COLLECTED AND REVIEWED BY THE CORPORATE SECRETARY AND CONTROLLER AND MAINTAINED ON FILE. FOLLOWING DISCLOSURE, THE INDIVIDUAL WILL NOT PARTICIPATE IN THE DISCUSSION OR DECISION-MAKING PROCESS. POTENTIAL CONFLICTS ARE REPORTED TO THE CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER (COO), AND THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE DETERMINES WHETHER A CONFLICT EXISTS AND WHETHER ADDITIONAL ACTIONS ARE NECESSARY. IF A DISPUTE ARISES REGARDING THE EXISTENCE OF A CONFLICT, THE HEAD OF SCHOOL DETERMINES WHETHER A CONFLICT EXISTS FOR EMPLOYEES AND ESTABLISHES THE APPROPRIATE RESPONSE, WHILE THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES DETERMINES CONFLICTS INVOLVING THE HEAD OF SCHOOL OR MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EXECUTIVE SALARY IS DETERMINED BASED ON A COMPARABILITY STUDY AND VOTED ON BY THE BOARD. OTHER OFFICERS SALARIES ARE DETERMINED BASED ON ANNUAL BUDGET AND VOTED ON BY THE BOARD. A COMPARATIVE STUDY IS PERFORMED AND DATA FROM THE CAL-ISBOA SALARY SURVEY ARE USED TO DETERMINE THE SALARIES FOR THE BUDGET.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST.
